articles.summary: This year, Abercrombie & Fitch is building on its multi-year partnership with the National Football League (NFL), bringing expanded assortments, broader distribution and season-long activations to fans. In its second year as the Official Fashion Partner of the NFL, Abercrombie will continue to represent all 32 NFL teams through licensed product across men’s, women’s, kids’.
articles.title: A&F and NFL Build on Official Fashion Partnership

articles.summary: Today, we announced our second quarter financial results, marking our 15th consecutive quarter of net sales growth. articles.title: A&F Co. Announces Q2 2026 Earnings Results
